{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Limi''''' was a group of 3 [[Class-A cargo container]]s containing supplies, as part of a small [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] outpost holding multiple [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] and [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]]. A single [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] was dispatched to destroy the outpost as the fighters had no pilots. [[Utility Tug/Legends|Utility Tug]]s ''[[T-XL]]'' attempted to scramble the pilots to the fighters but were destroyed by the TIE Fighter and all X-wings and A-wings were destroyed. The containers '''Limi''', along with [[Vic]] were left as the final target.
